dogecoin.text:
Did you know?

In 2021, Dogecoin saw an unprecedented surge of over 12,000%, fueled by memes, celebrity endorsements, and its community, despite being created as a joke in 2013.

FUN FACT

Shiba Inu, dubbed the 'Dogecoin Killer,' skyrocketed by over 1,000,000% in 2021. It turned small investments into life-changing fortunes!
